newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Kuok applies to float Allgreen Properties - paper.
newsitem.headline: Kuok applies to float Allgreen Properties - paper.

text.p: Malaysian tycoon Robert Kuok has again applied to list Allgreen Properties on the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES), less than a year after its application was withdrawn because of unconducive market conditions, the Business Times said on Saturday.
The daily newspaper quoted unnamed sources as saying Allgreen recently filed a listing application with the SES, naming DBS Bank as the lead manager.
Allgreen has about Singapore $1.4 billion in assets, the Business Times said.
